scenario.name: urgent_symptom
scenario.goal: Get guidance on a severe headache that has lasted 2 days
scenario.context: Existing patient, headache started 2 days ago, over-the-counter meds not helping
scenario.personality: Worried but calm, describes symptoms clearly
scenario.notes: Rate the pain as 7 out of 10. Ask if you need to be seen today or can wait.

turns.speaker: agent
